existing_owner_browser_probe.next_recovery: The canonical Vault metadata has no identifiable reviewer login. The existing Store Test instructions page may hold a credential, but supported browser scripting is denied and native AX capture is unsafe under D79. Prefer a first-party magic link for the same existing enabled nonadmin identity, with no email and no password change, in the release owner's isolated acceptance browser. Establish a fresh real session and independent zero-admin-assignment proof. A magic-link pass proves existing-account signed-in behavior, not password-login readiness. Do not create a new account while this existing-user path remains available.

credential_readiness.result: No existing valid reviewer password was recovered. The authenticated owner Vault and read-only canonical metadata census found no identifiable reviewer login; the only aimatrx.com website login item is the admin test account. No password value, auth token, or account identifier was printed or copied. No reviewer credential was retried, reset, rotated, or committed.
credential_readiness.next_safe_source: The first-party ai-matrx app/api/admin/users/auth-link/route.ts supports super-admin generation of a single-use magic link for an existing user with send:false. Use the confirmed existing nonadmin user ID, keep the returned action_link private, and navigate it through the official Supabase verify/auth callback in the isolated acceptance browser; then use the extension's normal OAuth path. This avoids password rotation, account creation, email transmission, token injection, and admin masquerading. It does not establish password sign-in readiness. Do not use the native CUA app-selection path from EXT-D-0079.

candidate_acceptance.hosted_path: scripts/hosted-guest-acceptance.mjs currently admits guest-chat and settings-controls only. A signed-in reviewer hosted run needs a reviewed, guarded runner path and a private secret injection mechanism; no hosted member acceptance is claimed.
candidate_acceptance.existing_account_magic_link_path: The production https://www.aimatrx.com/api/admin/users/auth-link route responded 401 to an unauthenticated POST, proving it is deployed and authority-gated. Source at ai-matrx app/api/admin/users/auth-link/route.ts requires requireSuperAdmin, whose admin-lane guard accepts /api/admin from an Administration referer. POST type=magiclink, existing confirmed nonadmin userId, send=false returns a single-use action_link without emailing it or changing a password. The generated Supabase link must be consumed by the official /auth/confirm token_hash verifier or supported callback in the release owner's isolated browser; verify first-party session, normal extension OAuth, nonadmin role, organization, and real Chat response. The link lifetime was not independently measured, so generate it just before browser consumption and keep link and session artifacts private. This proves existing-account signed-in behavior, not reviewer password-form readiness.
candidate_acceptance.safety_limit: EXT-D-0079 native accessibility capture remains open. Do not inspect a real credential through CUA app re-selection; any capture-path retest uses synthetic or disposable credentials only.
